CROSS_CELL_TRANSFER.applicability_scope: units disjoint from calibration, inside the declared applicability domain
CROSS_CELL_TRANSFER.meaning: the family calibrated on some units predicts held-out data of OTHER units within the declared bar
CROSS_CELL_TRANSFER.refusal_condition: as within-cell; OUT_OF_DOMAIN also when a held-out unit was a calibration unit
CROSS_CELL_TRANSFER.required_evidence: as within-cell, for a held-out set whose units are disjoint from the calibration units

IDENTIFIABILITY.applicability_scope: the declared family, the calibration set's design, and the declared parameter bounds
IDENTIFIABILITY.meaning: every requested LATENT_PARAMETER of the declared family is determined by the calibration observations (IDENTIFIABLE), or at least one is not (NOT_IDENTIFIABLE)
IDENTIFIABILITY.refusal_condition: REPRESENTATION_UNAVAILABLE: the family cannot be bound to declared roles or a requested parameter is not a declared LATENT_PARAMETER; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: full rank but no declared noise, or a weakly identified ridge (REVIEW)
IDENTIFIABILITY.required_evidence: the residual Jacobian of the bound family at the calibrated estimate; IDENTIFIABLE also needs a declared measurement noise, from which the local covariance is classified by the frozen V1 identifiability rule (engcore.hybrid_uq.identifiability); a rank-deficient Jacobian decides NOT_IDENTIFIABLE without one

MODEL_ADEQUACY.applicability_scope: the declared family on the calibration set
MODEL_ADEQUACY.meaning: the calibrated declared family describes the calibration data within the declared adequacy bar (or, with no bar, within the declared measurement noise)
MODEL_ADEQUACY.refusal_condition: REPRESENTATION_UNAVAILABLE: the family cannot be bound; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: neither a bar nor a noise is declared, or the fit fails
MODEL_ADEQUACY.required_evidence: calibration residuals of the best fit, compared with a declared bar (rmse and p95) or with a declared noise (chi-square at 0.999)

MODEL_DISCREPANCY.applicability_scope: the declared family on the calibration set, at the stated resolution
MODEL_DISCREPANCY.meaning: the calibrated family's residuals show structured model-form error beyond the declared measurement noise (PRESENT), or no discrepancy is resolved above it (UNRESOLVED; never 'zero')
MODEL_DISCREPANCY.refusal_condition: REPRESENTATION_UNAVAILABLE: the family cannot be bound; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: no declared noise and no structure resolved (compatibility cannot be shown without a declared noise)
MODEL_DISCREPANCY.required_evidence: residual chi-square against a declared noise and/or lag-1 residual autocorrelation against a declared independence of the measurement noise

WITHIN_CELL_GENERALIZATION.applicability_scope: calibration units only, inside the declared applicability domain
WITHIN_CELL_GENERALIZATION.meaning: the calibrated family predicts held-out data of the SAME unit(s) within the declared acceptance bar
WITHIN_CELL_GENERALIZATION.refusal_condition: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: no such set or no bar; OUT_OF_DOMAIN: a held-out trajectory leaves the declared domain or belongs to another unit; REPRESENTATION_UNAVAILABLE: the family cannot be bound
WITHIN_CELL_GENERALIZATION.required_evidence: held-out prediction error of the calibrated family against the declared bar, after every held-out trajectory is shown inside the declared applicability domain
